page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or onboard GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data positions this instance in the average performance tier across most compute and memory metrics. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a single-core Geekbench score of 1532.0 and a multi-core score of 13384.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 35326.14. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only large block bandwidth of 141.73 GB/sec and a write large block bandwidth of 65.94 GB/sec. Notably, the instance demonstrates strong performance in text generation for small language models with 135M parameters, reaching 282.15 tokens/sec, while maintaining average throughput for medium models with 7B parameters at 17.54 tokens/sec.

Given its high memory density and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.r7.8xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require substantial memory footprints without the overhead of local storage maintenance. The absence of bundled local storage means storage costs are decoupled, allowing users to scale network storage independently. This profile is highly suitable for memory-intensive workloads such as in-memory databases, caching layers like Redis, enterprise applications, and moderate data processing tasks.
